name: implicit-integration
description: Guide Implicit adapter integration and measured eager versus selective state comparisons.

interface.longDescription: Guide developers through connecting their existing agent and environment to Implicit Core. Identify immutable experience addresses, page boundaries, source versions and native verification; build adapters in the caller project; compare eager and selective state semantics, retained serialized bytes and full pipeline latency. Requires a local coding environment for SDK execution. No hosted MCP, arbitrary uploaded-code execution, learning improvements or general speedups are promised.
interface.defaultPrompt: Plan an Implicit adapter for my existing agent environment.
